role: Extension on HealthKitManager that reads HealthKit workouts for the heat-acclimatization model and reduces outdoor ones to (date, minutes, weather) inputs.
types: HealthKitManager.HeatWorkoutInput: struct — one outdoor workout's date, duration minutes and WorkoutWeatherSnapshot?
state: mem:HealthKitManager.outdoorCapableTypes (static Set<HKWorkoutActivityType> of 25 outdoor-capable activity types)

units.does: Queries all HKWorkouts (any source) whose start lies in [startOfToday - days, now] sorted by end date descending, bounded by the 30 s background timeout, and maps them through heatInputs; returns [] when HealthKit is unavailable, the start date can't be computed, or the query times out. Called by HeatAcclimationCache.

branches.cond: Calendar fails to compute start = startOfToday - days

branches.effect: ?? [] — returns an empty list, indistinguishable from no outdoor workouts

units.does: Casts samples to [HKWorkout] and keeps those lasting at least 1 minute that isOutdoorWorkout accepts, mapping each to HeatWorkoutInput(date: startDate, durationMinutes, weather: WorkoutWeatherSnapshot(healthKitMetadata:observedAt:)).

branches.cond: samples is nil or not castable to [HKWorkout] (query error)
workout shorter than 1 min OR not outdoor
branches.effect: dropped (nil from compactMap); otherwise converted to a HeatWorkoutInput

units.does: Returns !indoor when the workout metadata carries HKMetadataKeyIndoorWorkout as Bool; else, for a swim carrying HKMetadataKeySwimmingLocationType, whether it was open water (a pool swim is not heat exposure); otherwise whether the activity type is in outdoorCapableTypes.

branches.cond: metadata has a swimming location type
